text: 一是实施“以旧换新”购房贷款补贴。在本《通知》实施之日起至2027年3月31日，居民家庭在本市外环外购买新建商品住房并完成合同网签备案，且在网签备案日前后1年内出售本市二手住房的，可向购入新建商品住房所在区房地产交易中心申请补贴。补贴金额按购买新建商品住房贷款总额的1%计算，单套住房最高补贴5万元；补贴总金额2亿元，用完即止。
text_en: First, implement a "trade-in" home purchase loan subsidy. From the effective date of this Notice until March 31, 2027, households purchasing new commercial housing outside the Outer Ring Road with completed online contract filing, and selling their Shanghai second-hand home within one year before or after the filing date, may apply to the district real estate transaction center where the new home is located for a subsidy. The subsidy is calculated at 1% of the total loan amount for the new home purchase, capped at RMB 50,000 per unit; the total subsidy pool is RMB 200 million, available on a first-come, first-served basis until exhausted.
